### RSD% of the volumetric internal standards {.unnumbered}

RSD% of the raw vIS peak areas within groups of samples (all samples, also outliers). Filter the
table by grouping or group; the matrix tab shows all groups side by side.

```{r}
vis_rsd <- show$vis_rsd_table(raw[["raw"]][vis_rows, smp$sample_id, drop = FALSE],
                              SumExp::row_df(raw)$feature_name[vis_rows], smp)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Table

```{r}
dt(mutate(vis_rsd, Grouping = factor(Grouping), Group = factor(Group)), search = FALSE)
```

#### Matrix

```{r}
vis_rsd |> mutate(col = paste0(Group, " (", Grouping, ")")) |>
  select(vIS, col, `RSD%`) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = `RSD%`) |> dt(search = FALSE)
```

:::
